description: This Java class 'LogDownloader' provides a UI component for managing log files from an ECU, including listing, deleting, and downloading log files through commands sent to the device and handling responses.

classes.name: LogDownloader
classes.description: A UI component class for interacting with log files from the ECU, allowing listing, deleting, and downloading logs.

methods.name: LogDownloader
methods.description: Constructor initializing the log downloader UI component and setting up message listener.

methods.name: createFilePanel
methods.description: Creates a UI panel representing a log file with options to delete or download.

methods.name: resetLogsList
methods.description: Clears the list of displayed log files.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the main content panel of the UI component.

methods.name: showContent
methods.description: Prepares and displays the UI for managing log files, including a refresh button.

methods.name: listDirectory
methods.description: Sends a command to list the log directory on the ECU.
